probes.prompt: In one sentence, explain why safe_mode=false matters for provider testing.

observations: Probes 1 and 2 experienced ~45s latency before failing — consistent with Kimi timeout (~45s threshold)
After Kimi timeout, chain advances through codex -> llama8b -> deepseek14b
By the time chain reaches deepseek14b, budget is exhausted (negative seconds left)
Probe 3 succeeded immediately (~2.5s) with Kimi FAST_SUCCESS, suggesting intermittent latency spikes rather than permanent Kimi unavailability
provider_probe flag was set true internally by Brain, not requested in metadata
implications: safe_mode=false patch is insufficient alone; provider chain budget exhaustion blocks reliable Kimi usage when intermittent timeouts occur
Same-provider retry is absent; a single timeout exhausts the entire chain budget
Cannot proceed to 30-cycle autonomy until provider chain budget/timeout policy is tuned or retry logic added
